c20_starting_cluster.scope_selection: The DR-00 canonical specimen's one exact production volume is the selected C20 STARTING_CLUSTER scope for this DR convergence fixture. Selection is valid only while the canonical descriptor has nonzero AUTH-0093 Iron opportunity; otherwise the result is REPLAN_REQUIRED.
c20_starting_cluster.satisfaction: The canonical descriptor is Iron-eligible, and the accepted exact-volume Iron plan is present and deterministic. This proves only C20's Iron scope-selection condition; it does not set a quantity, reserve, grade, accessibility, route, trade/salvage, or full first-aircraft material-budget policy.

retained_realization_invariants.copper: accepted vanilla Copper exact-volume deployment; POST_FLIGHT_PROVINCE only
retained_realization_invariants.zinc: accepted Create Zinc exact-volume deployment with C21 noncompetition; POST_FLIGHT_PROVINCE only

verification.fail_closed: If the DR-00 identity changes, C20 no longer assigns Iron to STARTING_CLUSTER, or the canonical descriptor has zero Iron opportunity, the evidence guard fails and no substitute specimen or injected deposit is selected.
